name: Aanya Chand
bio:
Aanya Chand, 15 years of age is a student and writer from Mumbai, she shares her passion for literature through social media, aspiring to encourage young adults to
more, authentically express themselves.
Owning a ‘bookstagram’, she is also an avid reader. Having started writing at 11, “Fairytales” is her very first publication
_bio_source: title_master_go_live.xlsx, About the Author for “Fairytales – A Poetry Anthology” (ISBN 9789395764247); sole-author title and the text names them

name: Amit Sinha
bio: Amit Sinha is the co—founder Director of AAI. He pursued his M.A. and LLB from Delhi University. He also holds Post Graduate Diploma in Rural Development. He has been guiding the aspirants of Civil Services Examination for past 10 years on subjects like Indian Economy, International Relations and Social Issues. Under his guidance, many aspirants have cracked the Civil Services Examination.
_bio_source: title_master_go_live.xlsx, About the Author for “Indian Economy” (ISBN 9789391032272); sole-author title and the text names them

name: P Kumar
bio: P. Kumar is a core geographer. He completed his undergraduate, Master of Arts and Master of Philosophy degrees from the Department of Geography, Delhi School of Economics, University of Delhi. He teaches as an Assistant Professor (adhoc) at Swami Shraddhanand University, Delhi University. He has also been a visiting lecturer for Civil Services Academy at Pandit Deen Dayal Petroleum University, Gandhinagar, Sr. Lecturer at Srichaitanya Degree University, Hyderabad, and Lecturer in Geography at reputed coaching institutions.
_bio_source: title_master_go_live.xlsx, About the Author for “Disaster Management” (ISBN 9789395764629); sole-author title and the text names them

name: Pramod Rao
bio: Pramod Rao is a former Executive Director at the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), and former Board Member of IFSCA, NFRA, and IICA.
_bio_source: title_master_go_live.xlsx, About the Author for “In-House Matters” (ISBN 9788199888111); sole-author title and the text names them

name: Praveen Kumar
bio: Praveen Kumar has been a core geographer. He has completed his graduation, Master of Arts and Master of Philosophy from Dept. of Geography, Delhi School of Economics, University of Delhi. He has also completed Remote Sensing and GIS training from National Atlas and Thematic Mapping Organisation (NATMO), Kolkata, West Bengal. For the last fifteen years, he has been devoted in research and teaching.
_bio_source: title_master_go_live.xlsx, About the Author for “Disaster Management” (ISBN 9789389176117); sole-author title and the text names them

name: Surendra Raut
bio: Surendra Raut is the well known faculty of Maithili and General Knowledge. He has been guiding the students for past 10 years in the domain of Civil Services and Bihar State Services Examination. Under his guidance, many students have achieved success by cracking various examinations.
_bio_source: title_master_go_live.xlsx, About the Author for “Bihar At a Glance” (ISBN 9788193917114); sole-author title and the text names them
